Summary: EPIC-FUT: Future Campus Innovations & Mess Integration
Description:
Theme: Advanced Campus Intelligence, Mess Integrations, and Zero-Friction Automation.

Goal: Extend PROTOMANIA into an indispensable campus utility by integrating directly with hostel mess menus, camera vision OCR, WhatsApp conversational logging, and campus offline commerce partnerships.

Scope: Hostel mess timetable parser, noticeboard OCR camera scanner, Quick-Commerce cart export, WhatsApp bot, roommate expense splitter, campus tuck shop QR discount pass, exam week fuel mode, crowd-sourced mess ratings, micronutrient radar, and community kettle recipe hub.

Summary: FUT-01: Interactive Hostel Mess Menu Integration & Deficit Compensator
Description:
User Story:
As a hostel resident eating mandatory mess food,
I want to select my university/hostel or input my hostel's weekly mess timetable on the diet page,
So that the app automatically calculates how much protein the mess provides and recommends the exact cheap snacks needed to bridge the remaining deficit within my budget.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GIVEN the student navigates to the Diet Plans page (`#/meals`)
- WHEN they switch to 'Mess Survival Mode' and input their weekly mess schedule (e.g., Tuesday Lunch: Kadhi Pakoda + Rice + Salad)
- THEN the system calculates the mess nutritional yield (~8g protein, 520 kcal), flags the protein deficit (e.g., Need +72g more protein to hit 80g target), and algorithmically generates supplemental pocket-money snacks (e.g., 50g Sattu shake + 2 boiled eggs = +25g protein for ₹22) to complete the day within their declared stipend.

Summary: FUT-02: Mess Noticeboard Camera OCR & WhatsApp PDF Menu Importer
Description:
User Story:
As a lazy hosteler who doesn't want to type out a 7-day mess timetable manually,
I want to snap a photo of the printed hostel mess noticeboard (or upload a PDF sent on the hostel WhatsApp group),
So that Vision AI parses the schedule into my weekly meal planner in under 5 seconds.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GIVEN the Mess Menu settings page
- WHEN the student uploads an image or PDF of their mess timetable
- THEN the multimodal OCR pipeline extracts day-by-day Breakfast, Lunch, Snacks, and Dinner, maps the Indian dish names (e.g., Rajma, Aloo Gobi, Sambhar, Egg Curry), displays a preview for user confirmation, and populates the 7-day schedule.

User Story:
As a student viewing my generated 7-Day Bulk Grocery Haul,
I want to click 'Export to Blinkit / Zepto / Instamart',
So that all raw items (e.g., 500g Sattu, 30-egg crate, 1kg Rolled Oats) are pre-loaded into an online grocery cart with student discount codes applied.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GIVEN the 7-day grocery modal (`#/meals`)
- WHEN the student clicks 'Buy Wholesale on Quick-Commerce'
- THEN the system generates a deep-link with SKU mappings to local delivery apps, sorting by the cheapest vendor available in the campus pincode.

Summary: FUT-04: WhatsApp & Telegram Conversational Micro-Logging Bot
Description:
User Story:
As an active student who forgets to open the website after every meal,
I want to send a quick WhatsApp text or voice note (e.g., 'Bhai 2 boiled ande aur ek glass sattu piya'),
So that my daily dashboard automatically updates and awards +50 XP without opening a browser.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GIVEN a student linked via their mobile number
- WHEN they message the PROTOMANIA WhatsApp bot in English, Hindi, or Hinglish
- THEN NLP extracts the food items, calculates protein and calories, updates their database meal_logs, and replies with an instant summary: 'Logged 23g Protein! You have 42g left to hit today\'s target. +50 XP!'

Summary: FUT-05: Roommate & Flatmate Shared Cooking Expense Splitter
Description:
User Story:
As a student sharing an apartment or hostel floor with gym buddies,
I want to link my profile with my flatmates for shared bulk cooking (e.g., boiling 12 eggs or making a 6-serving chicken curry),
So that the system splits the ingredient costs equally while logging individual protein shares accurately.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GIVEN a group of 2–4 flatmates linked in a shared cooking squad
- WHEN one user logs a batch meal (e.g., Batch: Besan Chilla for 3 people)
- THEN the grocery expense is split across their pocket-money trackers, and each user receives their individual macro allocation.

Summary: FUT-06: Campus Tuck Shop / Local Kirana QR Code Discount Pass
Description:
User Story:
As a broke student buying daily eggs or milk from the campus tuck shop,
I want to scan a PROTOMANIA Student Pass QR code at partnered campus stores,
So that I receive a 5%–10% discount on healthy high-protein staples.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GIVEN the student's mobile dashboard
- WHEN they present their digital 'ProtoPass QR' to a verified campus tuck shop vendor
- THEN the merchant scans it, applies the negotiated student discount, and logs the purchase directly into the student's food budget.

Summary: FUT-07: Exam-Week Late-Night 'Brain Fuel & Anti-Carb-Coma' Mode
Description:
User Story:
As an engineering or medical student during mid-term and semester exams,
I want an 'Exam-Week Brain Fuel' toggle,
So that the meal planner avoids heavy, sleep-inducing refined carbs (preventing afternoon lethargy) and recommends light, sustained-energy protein snacks with caffeine hacks.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GIVEN the Living Mode switcher
- WHEN the student selects 'Exam Week'
- THEN the planner eliminates high-glycemic lethargy-inducing heavy meals (e.g., heavy mess fried rice), prioritizing roasted chana, dark roast black coffee, dahi with fruits, and light chillas designed to sustain focus without afternoon slumps.

Summary: FUT-08: College Mess 'Crowd-Sourced Food Quality & Protein Rating'
Description:
User Story:
As a hosteler walking into the canteen,
I want to view live ratings from my college peers on today's mess food (e.g., 'Is today\'s mess dal watery or thick?', 'How oily is the egg bhurji?'),
So that I know whether to eat in the mess or activate my backup kettle meal.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GIVEN the Mess Menu tab on `#/meals`
- WHEN students on the same campus vote on today's meal quality (1 to 5 stars + thickness/oil tags)
- THEN a live community badge displays: 'Today\'s Lunch: Watery Dal Alert (Estimated only 4g protein) — Backup snack recommended.'

Summary: FUT-09: Indian Student Micronutrient Deficiency Radar (Vit B12, D3, Iron)
Description:
User Story:
As a student feeling constant fatigue,
I want the system to track common Indian vegetarian deficiencies (Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3, Iron, Zinc),
So that my diet plan incorporates low-cost dietary sources (fortified milk, sunlight timings, amla, curry leaves) without expensive blood panels.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GIVEN a vegetarian or vegan student profile
- WHEN the optimizer evaluates their 7-day intake
- THEN an advisory card warns about common bioavailability bottlenecks (e.g., non-heme iron absorption) and suggests pairing chana with lemon/vitamin C to double absorption.

Summary: FUT-10: Community Hostel Kettle Hack Recipe Voting & Submissions
Description:
User Story:
As a creative hosteler who invented a clever kettle cooking technique,
I want to submit my recipe (e.g., 'Kettle Poached Eggs on Toasted Bread' or 'Oatmeal Sattu Mug Cake'),
So that other college students across India can vote on it and have it featured in the official budget planner.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GIVEN the Community Hub view
- WHEN a user posts a recipe with prep time, rupee cost, and photo
- THEN peer students can upvote; recipes reaching 100+ campus upvotes automatically enter the knapsack food catalog as verified community meals.
